subset_rule: only remove rows from joint-model estimation; keep previously learned rating histories and frozen baseline flag definitions
rank_policy: outcome-free pivoted QR; remove redundant parameters; original reference prediction only if all positive scenario rows lie in estimation row-space
nonestimable_reference_policy: original target remains empty; optional common estimable reference gets a NEW ID and explicit changed-target label, with baseline model evaluated on same new reference
mixture_policy: use registered rational scenario weights; conditionalize only on explicitly registered common reference, never reselect score-overlap intersection
score_reference_policy: same population membership and weights, variant-specific score distributions; separate score-input identity; not a causal decomposition
